deadline.value: For assistantship consideration, send the application and department forms by December 1 for the Fall semester.
deadline.quote: Ph.D. students who wish to be considered for an assistantship should have their application and Department forms sent in by December 1 for the Fall Semester.

supervisor.value: Applicants name one preferred faculty member and are strongly encouraged to contact that person before or during applying.
supervisor.quote: PhD applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the specific faculty member of interest prior to or during the application process.

also.quote: PHD applicants will need to include information about their intended research specialization (a singular/specific focus) and one preferred faculty member

funding.value: Unconditionally admitted students may receive scholarship or fellowship support, on the same criteria as admission.
funding.quote: Students unconditionally admitted to the program are eligible for scholarship and fellowship support.

also.quote: The criteria applied will be the same as those applied to admission decisions.

toefl_min.value: The page sets a TOEFL iBT total of 79 with section minimums (Writing 22, Speaking 21, Reading 20, Listening 16).

ielts_min.value: The page sets an IELTS Academic score of 6.5 with a Speaking score of 7.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether applicants enter from a bachelor's or a master's.

notes: Filed under neuroscience because it is the Health/Neuroscience specialization of the psychology PhD. The page's English table and the university minimums agree.
name: Experimental Psychology PhD (Health/Neuroscience)
